entries.scheme_name: ASPIRE (Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industry & Entrepreneurship)
entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
entries.text: ASPIRE (Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industry & Entrepreneurship) ASPIRE Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Sets up Livelihood Business Incubators (LBIs) and Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) to promote rural agro-business enterprise creation and employment. Agro-rural entrepreneurs, educational institutions, or technical bodies setting up LBI/TBI incubators in rural/semi-urban areas. Focus on skilling youth and translating rural produce into value-added enterprise goods. One-time 100% grant of up to ₹1 Crore for government agencies and up to ₹50 Lakh for private bodies for plant and machinery procurement for LBI incubators. rural-industry lbi tbi agro-business aspire incubation Agro-Rural Industry Food Processing Rural Entrepreneurship Handicrafts
entries.snippet: Sets up Livelihood Business Incubators (LBIs) and Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) to promote rural agro-business enterprise creation and employment.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
entries.text: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund AIF Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare Medium-long term debt financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets. Agri-entrepreneurs, Startups, Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), FPOs, SHGs, and MSMEs setting up post-harvest management facilities. Eligible projects include cold chains, pack houses, silos, sorting/grading units, assaying units, and ripening chambers. Borrower must have credit approval from participating lending institutions. 3% interest subvention per annum on institutional loans up to ₹2 Crore for a maximum duration of 7 years, along with CGTMSE credit guarantee coverage fee paid by Government. agriculture cold-chain warehousing subvention post-harvest Agriculture Cold Storage Warehousing Food Processing Supply Chain
entries.snippet: Medium-long term debt financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Textiles
entries.text: Amended Technology Upgradation Fund Scheme (ATUFS) ATUFS Ministry of Textiles Capital investment subsidy for the modernization and technology induction in textile segments including garmenting, technical textiles, weaving, and processing. Entity engaged in textile manufacturing intending to install benchmarked state-of-the-art machinery. Must obtain Unique Identification Number (UID) from i-TUFS portal prior to machinery acquisition. Term loan availed from notified lending banks/financial institutions. Capital Investment Subsidy (CIS) of 10% to 15% on eligible benchmarked machinery with a subsidy ceiling up to ₹30 Crore depending on textile sub-segment. textiles garmenting capital-investment-subsidy atufs machinery-modernization Textiles & Apparel Technical Textiles Garmenting Weaving Spinning
entries.snippet: Capital investment subsidy for the modernization and technology induction in textile segments including garmenting, technical textiles, weaving, and processing.

entries.scheme_name: Atal Innovation Mission - Seed & Incubation Support
entries.nodal_ministry: NITI Aayog
entries.text: Atal Innovation Mission - Seed & Incubation Support AIM NITI Aayog Catalyzes world-class startups through Atal Incubation Centres (AICs) with prototyping labs, maker spaces, and access to seed grants. Innovators and early-stage ventures working on technology, circular economy, rural development, or high-impact social solutions. Must apply to and be shortlisted by an Atal Incubation Centre (AIC) or Established Incubation Centre (EIC). Clear intent to incorporate a commercial enterprise in India. Incubation access, state-of-the-art laboratory infrastructure, corporate POCs, and micro seed grants ranging from ₹5 Lakh to ₹25 Lakh. niti-aayog incubator prototyping innovation seed-grant ALL
entries.snippet: Catalyzes world-class startups through Atal Incubation Centres (AICs) with prototyping labs, maker spaces, and access to seed grants.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Science & Technology - Department of Biotechnology
entries.text: Biotechnology Ignition Grant Scheme BIRAC-BIG Ministry of Science & Technology - Department of Biotechnology Flagship early-stage grant-in-aid of up to ₹50 Lakh for biotech, medtech, diagnostics, agri-biotech, and industrial biotechnology innovations. Biotech startup incorporated for not more than 5 years, or an individual innovator with verified institutional backing. Majority shareholding (> 51%) held by Indian citizens who are researchers, scientists, or medical entrepreneurs. Startups must possess an incubator affiliation or independent laboratory access. Clear scientific hypothesis and novel intellectual property path. Grant-in-aid up to ₹50 Lakh for milestone-based research and proof-of-concept validation over 18 months, with zero equity dilution. biotech medtech diagnostics non-dilutive-grant birac lifesciences Biotechnology Healthcare Medical Devices Agri-Biotech Bio-Pharma Industrial Biotechnology
entries.snippet: Flagship early-stage grant-in-aid of up to ₹50 Lakh for biotech, medtech, diagnostics, agri-biotech, and industrial biotechnology innovations.

entries.scheme_name: Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP) Maharashtra
entries.nodal_ministry: Industries Department, Government of Maharashtra
entries.text: Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP) Maharashtra CMEGP-MH Industries Department, Government of Maharashtra Maharashtra state credit-linked subsidy initiative providing margin money assistance to youth and micro-entrepreneurs for setting up manufacturing and service units. Resident of Maharashtra state between 18 and 45 years of age (up to 50 for SC/ST/Women/Ex-servicemen). Minimum Class 7th pass for project cost up to ₹10 Lakh, Class 10th pass for project cost above ₹10 Lakh. Only new manufacturing or service units established within the State of Maharashtra. Existing units cannot apply. Margin money subsidy of 15% to 35% of project cost: up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing projects and ₹20 Lakh for service units. 10% higher subsidy in rural and backward talukas. State Scheme Manufacturing Employment Margin Money Maharashtra Maharashtra State Scheme Margin Money Manufacturing Employment
entries.snippet: Maharashtra state credit-linked subsidy initiative providing margin money assistance to youth and micro-entrepreneurs for setting up manufacturing and service units.

entries.nodal_ministry: Industries Department, Government of Maharashtra
entries.text: Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (Maharashtra) CMEGP-MH Industries Department, Government of Maharashtra State flagship credit-linked subsidy scheme for youth and micro-entrepreneurs setting up manufacturing and service ventures in Maharashtra. Domicile resident of Maharashtra state aged 18 to 45 years (up to 50 years for SC/ST/Women/Ex-servicemen). Minimum 7th standard pass for project cost up to ₹10 Lakh, and 10th standard pass for project cost above ₹10 Lakh. Project must be located within the state of Maharashtra. Only for new micro-enterprises in manufacturing (up to ₹50 Lakh) or service (up to ₹20 Lakh). 15% to 35% capital subsidy (margin money) on project cost up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 Lakh for service units. maharashtra state-scheme cmegp margin-money dic youth-employment ALL
entries.snippet: State flagship credit-linked subsidy scheme for youth and micro-entrepreneurs setting up manufacturing and service ventures in Maharashtra.

entries.scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises
entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
entries.text: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises CGTMSE Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Collateral-free credit facility for micro and small enterprises with guarantee coverage up to ₹5 Crore backed by SIDBI and Ministry of MSME. New and existing Micro and Small Enterprises (Manufacturing and Services). Retail trade enterprises up to ₹2 Crore exposure. Educational institutions and training centers. No third-party guarantee or collateral required. Guarantee coverage up to 85% for loans up to ₹5 Lakh (Micro), 75% to 85% for loans up to ₹500 Lakh. Up to 85% coverage for women-owned enterprises and units in NER. Collateral Free Term Loan Working Capital SIDBI MSME Credit Guarantee ALL
entries.snippet: Collateral-free credit facility for micro and small enterprises with guarantee coverage up to ₹5 Crore backed by SIDBI and Ministry of MSME.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
entries.text: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS) CGSS Ministry of Commerce and Industry Provides credit guarantees to loans extended by Scheduled Commercial Banks, NBFCs, and AIFs to DPIIT-recognized startups without collateral. DPIIT-recognized Startups with verified GST and operational bank records. Startups seeking debt financing without third-party collateral. No default in any existing credit facility. Credit guarantee coverage up to 85% of sanctioned facility up to ₹10 Crore per startup borrower. Startups Debt Financing Collateral-Free Credit Guarantee Credit Guarantee Debt Financing Startups Collateral-Free
entries.snippet: Provides credit guarantees to loans extended by Scheduled Commercial Banks, NBFCs, and AIFs to DPIIT-recognized startups without collateral.

entries.scheme_name: Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (MSME Champions Scheme)
entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
entries.text: Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (MSME Champions Scheme) CLCSS Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises 15% upfront capital subsidy for micro and small enterprises to modernize plant, equipment, and machinery with state-of-the-art technology in 51 approved sub-sectors. Registered Micro and Small Enterprises having valid Udyam Registration. Must be upgrading existing plant and machinery or establishing new facility with proven technology in approved sub-sectors. Loan availed from scheduled commercial banks, state financial corporations, or SIDBI/NABARD. Replacement of obsolete technology with modern energy-efficient machinery. 15% upfront capital subsidy on institutional term loan availed for purchase of eligible machinery, calculated on loan up to ₹1 Crore (Maximum subsidy ₹15 Lakh). machinery technology-upgrade manufacturing capital-subsidy champions Manufacturing Engineering Textiles Food Processing Plastics Chemicals Electronics
entries.snippet: 15% upfront capital subsidy for micro and small enterprises to modernize plant, equipment, and machinery with state-of-the-art technology in 51 approved sub-sectors.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
entries.text: Fund of Funds for Startups FFS Ministry of Commerce and Industry ₹10,000 Crore corpus managed by SIDBI contributing capital to SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs), which invest directly in innovative DPIIT-recognized startups. Startup must be recognized by DPIIT. Must be incorporated as a Private Limited Company. Company age must not exceed 10 years from the date of incorporation. Startup must demonstrate innovative business model, scalable unit economics, and technology orientation. Venture equity and structured growth capital deployed via SIDBI-partnered Daughter VC Funds (Series Pre-A, Series A, Series B). venture-capital equity sidbi growth-stage dpiit aif ALL
entries.snippet: ₹10,000 Crore corpus managed by SIDBI contributing capital to SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs), which invest directly in innovative DPIIT-recognized startups.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
entries.text: GENESIS (Gen-Next Support for Innovative Startups) GENESIS Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology ₹490 Crore umbrella initiative to discover, support, and scale tech startups from Tier-II and Tier-III cities across India with discovery grants and pilot linkages. DPIIT-recognized tech startups registered and operating out of Tier-II and Tier-III cities. Tech-driven product or intellectual property. Indian promoter ownership > 51%. Financial grants up to ₹25 Lakh for pilot rollouts, cloud infrastructure credits, and direct market access partnerships. tier-2-tier-3 meity tech-startups cloud-credits genesis Information Technology Electronic System Design EdTech AgriTech FinTech
entries.snippet: ₹490 Crore umbrella initiative to discover, support, and scale tech startups from Tier-II and Tier-III cities across India with discovery grants and pilot linkages.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
entries.text: International Cooperation (IC) Scheme MSME-IC Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Financial assistance to MSMEs for participating in international exhibitions, trade fairs, buyer-seller meets, and technology transfer delegations abroad. Registered MSME with valid Udyam Registration and active IEC (Import Export Code). Must have an operational track record of at least 1 year. Participating in international fairs or business delegations approved under the IC guidelines. Reimbursement of 100% economy class airfare (up to ₹1.5 Lakh) and 100% space/stall rent (up to ₹3 Lakh) for individual MSME exporters participating in foreign events. export international-trade airfare-reimbursement global-fairs iec ALL
entries.snippet: Financial assistance to MSMEs for participating in international exhibitions, trade fairs, buyer-seller meets, and technology transfer delegations abroad.

entries.scheme_name: MSME Innovative Scheme (Incubation, Design and IPR)
entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
entries.text: MSME Innovative Scheme (Incubation, Design and IPR) MSME-INNOVATIVE Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Fosters innovation, commercialization of ideas, design thinking, and intellectual property development among MSMEs and tech startups. Registered MSMEs with valid Udyam Registration. Students, innovators, and start-ups associated with recognized Host Institutes (IITs, NITs, engineering colleges). Focus on developing novel proof of concepts and patentable technologies. Financial support up to ₹15 Lakh per approved idea for incubation; up to ₹40 Lakh for design projects; up to ₹5 Lakh for foreign patent registration. R&D IPR Patents Innovation Design Incubation Innovation IPR Patents Incubation Design R&D
entries.snippet: Fosters innovation, commercialization of ideas, design thinking, and intellectual property development among MSMEs and tech startups.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
entries.text: MSME Innovative Scheme (Incubation, Design, IPR) MSME-Innovative Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Holistic ecosystem combining Incubation grants, Professional Design subsidies, and IPR reimbursements for patents, trademarks, and design registrations. Any registered MSME with Udyam Registration or student/individual innovator affiliated with an approved Host Institute (HI). Must have an innovative concept, product design challenge, or registered patent/trademark requirement. Commercial potential and technological viability. Financial assistance: Up to ₹15 Lakh for idea incubation; Up to ₹40 Lakh for design project (MSME contribution 25%); Up to ₹5 Lakh reimbursement for Foreign Patent, ₹1 Lakh for Domestic Patent, ₹10,000 for Trademark registration. ipr patent-reimbursement trademark industrial-design incubation champions ALL
entries.snippet: Holistic ecosystem combining Incubation grants, Professional Design subsidies, and IPR reimbursements for patents, trademarks, and design registrations.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
entries.text: MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification Scheme MSME-ZED Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Subsidizes comprehensive quality and environmental assessment (Zero Defect, Zero Effect) to enhance competitiveness, reduce waste, and access bank concessions. All manufacturing MSMEs registered with Udyam Registration. Enterprise must undertake the ZED pledge and undergo digital desktop / on-site verification. Valid GST registration required. Financial subsidy on certification cost: 80% for Micro, 60% for Small, 50% for Medium enterprises. Additional 10% subsidy for women/SC/ST owned units. Up to ₹5 Lakh reward for adopting zero-pollution green technology, plus bank loan interest concessions (0.25% - 0.50%). quality zed sustainability qci manufacturing green-certification Manufacturing
entries.snippet: Subsidizes comprehensive quality and environmental assessment (Zero Defect, Zero Effect) to enhance competitiveness, reduce waste, and access bank concessions.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
entries.text: MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification Scheme ZED Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Enables MSMEs to manufacture Zero Defect and Zero Effect goods through financial support on assessment and certification fees. Any Micro, Small, or Medium Enterprise with valid Udyam Registration. Must be an active manufacturing or production enterprise. Special additional financial subsidy of 10% for Women and SC/ST owned MSMEs. Financial assistance: 80% subsidy for Micro, 60% for Small, 50% for Medium on certification fees up to ₹5 Lakh. Environment Clean Energy Manufacturing Quality ZED ALL
entries.snippet: Enables MSMEs to manufacture Zero Defect and Zero Effect goods through financial support on assessment and certification fees.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
entries.text: MeitY SAMRIDH Scheme SAMRIDH Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology Scheme for Accelerating Startups for Scale-up through Mentorship, Funding, and Market Access, matching accelerator investments up to ₹40 Lakh per software tech startup. Software product startup with a demonstrable proof of concept, commercial traction, and customer validations. Must be DPIIT recognized and registered in India. Selected through a partner accelerator empanelled under MeitY SAMRIDH. Indian promoter holding must be greater than 51%. Matched funding up to ₹40 Lakh per startup along with 6-month customized accelerator cohort, corporate pilot linkages, and global investor demo day. software accelerator meity saas msh scaleup Information Technology Software SaaS DeepTech Artificial Intelligence Cybersecurity
entries.snippet: Scheme for Accelerating Startups for Scale-up through Mentorship, Funding, and Market Access, matching accelerator investments up to ₹40 Lakh per software tech startup.

entries.scheme_name: MeitY SAMRIDH Scheme for Tech Startups
entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
entries.text: MeitY SAMRIDH Scheme for Tech Startups SAMRIDH Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) Scheme for Accelerators to pick and scale early-stage software and deeptech product startups with matched government capital and investor cohorts. DPIIT Recognized Software Product Startups. Must have an operating prototype or market-ready SaaS/hardware/AI product. Must be admitted to an empaneled accelerator program. Matched equity/debt investment of up to ₹40 Lakh per startup alongside accelerator cohort funding. SaaS Deeptech Software MeitY Accelerator Software Deeptech Accelerator SaaS MeitY
entries.snippet: Scheme for Accelerators to pick and scale early-stage software and deeptech product startups with matched government capital and investor cohorts.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology - Department of Science & Technology
entries.text: NIDHI-Seed Support System (NIDHI-SSS) NIDHI-SSS Ministry of Science and Technology - Department of Science & Technology Debt and equity seed financing up to ₹1 Crore for technology-driven startups incubated in DST-supported Technology Business Incubators (TBIs). Registered startup incubated in a DST-approved Technology Business Incubator (TBI) for at least 3 months. Focus on commercializing indigenous, science-backed technologies and proprietary engineering. Indian promoter holding must be at least 51%. Financial seed support between ₹25 Lakh and ₹100 Lakh per startup via equity investment, convertible debentures, or soft loan. dst tbi deeptech seed-support equity hardware DeepTech Hardware CleanTech Electronics Materials Science
entries.snippet: Debt and equity seed financing up to ₹1 Crore for technology-driven startups incubated in DST-supported Technology Business Incubators (TBIs).

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
entries.text: National SC-ST Hub (NSSH) Scheme NSSH Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Specialized affirmative support ecosystem to empower SC/ST micro and small entrepreneurs to fulfill the 4% mandatory public procurement quota by CPSEs and ministries. Enterprise owned by SC/ST entrepreneurs (100% ownership in sole proprietorship, or at least 51% equity in partnership/company). Valid Udyam Registration and Caste Certificate of promoter. Applicant must be engaged in manufacturing or provision of services. 100% reimbursement of Single Point Registration Scheme (SPRS) fees, 100% annual credit guarantee fee reimbursement under CGTMSE, up to ₹1 Lakh subsidy for trade fairs, and subsidized tender document fees. sc-st affirmative-action nsic cgtmse-fee-reimbursement public-procurement ALL
entries.snippet: Specialized affirmative support ecosystem to empower SC/ST micro and small entrepreneurs to fulfill the 4% mandatory public procurement quota by CPSEs and ministries.

entries.scheme_name: PM Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises Scheme
entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Food Processing Industries / MSME
entries.text: PM Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises Scheme PMFME Ministry of Food Processing Industries / MSME Centrally sponsored scheme providing financial, technical, and business support for the upgradation of micro food processing enterprises. Existing or new micro food processing units (Individual proprietors, SHGs, FPOs, Cooperatives). Enterprise must be involved in food processing and manufacturing. Ownership status: Sole Proprietorship, Partnership, or LLP. Credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost with a maximum ceiling of ₹10 Lakh per unit. Micro Enterprises Food Processing Agri-Business Manufacturing ALL
entries.snippet: Centrally sponsored scheme providing financial, technical, and business support for the upgradation of micro food processing enterprises.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
entries.text: PM Vishwakarma Scheme PM-Vishwakarma Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises End-to-end holistic support for traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 designated trades, including skill training, ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, and collateral-free credit at 5% interest. An artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools, engaged in one of 18 family-based traditional trades. Minimum age of 18 years on the date of registration. The beneficiary should not have availed loans under similar credit-based schemes of Central or State Government (e.g. PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, Mudra) in the past 5 years. Registration is restricted to one member of the family. PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID card, ₹15,000 toolkit incentive e-voucher, basic & advanced training with ₹500/day stipend, and collateral-free credit support up to ₹3 Lakh (₹1 Lakh tranche-1 and ₹2 Lakh tranche-2) at concessional interest rate of 5%. artisans traditional-trades toolkit subvention carpenter blacksmith crafts Artisans & Crafts Manufacturing Handicrafts
entries.snippet: End-to-end holistic support for traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 designated trades, including skill training, ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, and collateral-free credit at 5% interest.

entries.scheme_name: PRISM Scheme (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs)
entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology - DSIR
entries.text: PRISM Scheme (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs) PRISM Ministry of Science and Technology - DSIR Grants up to ₹50 Lakh for individual innovators and MSMEs to translate novel, green, and industrial technical concepts into marketable working prototypes. Any individual innovator or registered micro/small enterprise with a novel technology idea. Proposal must demonstrate novelty, techno-commercial feasibility, and potential for patent protection. Cost of project evaluated across Phase I (Proof of Concept, max ₹5 Lakh) and Phase II (Working Prototype, max ₹50 Lakh). Grant-in-aid covering up to 90% of project cost for Phase I (up to ₹5 Lakh) and up to 50% of project cost for Phase II (up to ₹50 Lakh). dsir prototype green-technology individual-innovators prism Engineering Green Technology Renewable Energy Waste Management Agriculture
entries.snippet: Grants up to ₹50 Lakh for individual innovators and MSMEs to translate novel, green, and industrial technical concepts into marketable working prototypes.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Finance - Department of Financial Services
entries.text: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana - Kishore PMMY-Kishore Ministry of Finance - Department of Financial Services Mid-tier micro credit providing business loans from ₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000 for expanding micro business enterprises. Micro-enterprises that have already commenced operations and need funds between ₹50,000 and ₹5,00,000 for business expansion or machinery acquisition. Clean credit history and non-defaulter status. Valid business registration or establishment proof (GST / Shop & Est / Udyam). Term loan or working capital overdraft from ₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000 without collateral. mudra kishore expansion working-capital equipment-finance ALL
entries.snippet: Mid-tier micro credit providing business loans from ₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000 for expanding micro business enterprises.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Finance - Department of Financial Services
entries.text: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana - Shishu PMMY-Shishu Ministry of Finance - Department of Financial Services Micro-finance credit facility providing loans up to ₹50,000 for early-stage or very small micro-enterprises with minimal paperwork and zero collateral. Any Indian citizen who has a business plan for non-farm income-generating activity such as manufacturing, processing, trading, or service sector. Loan requirement is up to ₹50,000. No collateral required. Applicant must not be a defaulter to any bank or financial institution. Loans up to ₹50,000 at competitive bank interest rates, nil processing fee, and zero collateral security. mudra shishu micro-loan collateral-free small-shopkeeper vendor ALL
entries.snippet: Micro-finance credit facility providing loans up to ₹50,000 for early-stage or very small micro-enterprises with minimal paperwork and zero collateral.

entries.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana - Tarun & Tarun Plus
entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Finance - Department of Financial Services
entries.text: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana - Tarun & Tarun Plus PMMY-Tarun Ministry of Finance - Department of Financial Services Flagship credit facility offering loans from ₹5 Lakh up to ₹20 Lakh (Tarun Plus) for scaling mature micro businesses. Established micro and small business units requiring higher capital for scaling. Loan requirement between ₹5,00,000 and ₹10,00,000 (and up to ₹20 Lakh under Tarun Plus for previous borrowers who successfully repaid Tarun loans). Documented operating history of at least 1-2 years with positive cash flows. Credit facility from ₹5 Lakh up to ₹20 Lakh without collateral requirement. mudra tarun growth-capital tarun-plus scaleup ALL
entries.snippet: Flagship credit facility offering loans from ₹5 Lakh up to ₹20 Lakh (Tarun Plus) for scaling mature micro businesses.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Finance
entries.text: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) PMMY Ministry of Finance Refinance agency scheme funding non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises with collateral-free loans across Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories. Any Indian citizen with a viable business plan for income-generating non-farm activities. Sectors include manufacturing, processing, trading, retail, services, and allied agricultural activities. Loans in four tiers: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh), Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh), and Tarun Plus (up to ₹20 Lakh). Zero collateral requirement. PMMY Mudra Microfinance Collateral Free Working Capital ALL
entries.snippet: Refinance agency scheme funding non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises with collateral-free loans across Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
entries.text: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme PMEGP Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Credit-linked margin money subsidy scheme to generate self-employment by establishing micro-enterprises in manufacturing and services. Any individual above 18 years of age. Minimum Class 8th pass for manufacturing above ₹10 Lakh and services above ₹5 Lakh. New greenfield projects only; existing units are not eligible for first loan. Self Help Groups and Charitable Trusts are also eligible. Margin money subsidy of 25% (Urban) to 35% (Rural) for Special Categories (Women, SC, ST, OBC, Ex-servicemen); 15% to 25% for General. Max manufacturing cost ₹50 Lakh, service ₹20 Lakh. PMEGP Self Employment Subsidy Manufacturing Margin Money Rural PMEGP Margin Money Subsidy Self Employment Rural Manufacturing
entries.snippet: Credit-linked margin money subsidy scheme to generate self-employment by establishing micro-enterprises in manufacturing and services.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
entries.text: Procurement and Marketing Support (PMS) Scheme MSME-PMS Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Subsidizes participation in national and international trade fairs, marketing exhibitions, and modern retail packaging to enhance market linkage for MSMEs. Registered manufacturing or service MSMEs holding valid Udyam Registration. Participating in approved trade exhibitions, domestic expos, or onboarding to Government e-Marketplace (GeM). Special priority given to women, SC/ST, and units in North Eastern Region. Up to 100% stall charge reimbursement (up to ₹1.5 Lakh for domestic expos) and reimbursement of packaging and barcode certification costs. trade-fairs marketing exhibitions reimbursement gem-portal ALL
entries.snippet: Subsidizes participation in national and international trade fairs, marketing exhibitions, and modern retail packaging to enhance market linkage for MSMEs.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
entries.text: Procurement and Marketing Support (PMS) Scheme PMS Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Promotes new market access initiatives, participation in national/international trade fairs, vendor development, and modern e-commerce onboarding. Micro and Small Enterprises with valid Udyam Registration. Enterprises participating in state, national, or international trade exhibitions and expos. 100% stall charge reimbursement for SC/ST, Women, and NER entrepreneurs up to ₹1.5 Lakh for National Fairs; 80% for General MSEs. Marketing MSEs Trade Fairs Exhibitions Export ALL
entries.snippet: Promotes new market access initiatives, participation in national/international trade fairs, vendor development, and modern e-commerce onboarding.

entries.scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for Large Scale Electronics
entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
entries.text: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for Large Scale Electronics PLI-Electronics Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology Financial incentive of 4% to 6% on incremental sales (over base year) of goods manufactured in India covering mobile phones and specified electronic components. Companies incorporated in India engaged in domestic manufacturing of target electronics products. Must meet minimum threshold criteria of incremental cumulative investment in plant & machinery. Must achieve minimum incremental sales threshold of manufactured goods over the base year. Incentive of 4% to 6% on incremental sales (over base year) of goods manufactured in India for a period of 5 years. pli electronics manufacturing incremental-sales meity Electronics Semiconductor Hardware Manufacturing
entries.snippet: Financial incentive of 4% to 6% on incremental sales (over base year) of goods manufactured in India covering mobile phones and specified electronic components.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
entries.text: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for Large Scale Electronics PLI-ELECTRONICS Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) Offers an incentive of 4% to 6% on incremental sales (over base year) of goods manufactured in India to boost domestic electronic component manufacturing and attract large investments. Target segments: Mobile phones and specified electronic components (semiconductors, passive components, PCBs). Companies registered in India with committed cumulative investment and incremental sales thresholds. 4% to 6% incentive on incremental sales of manufactured goods for a period of 5 years following the base year. Hardware PLI Exports MeitY Manufacturing Electronics PLI Electronics Hardware Manufacturing MeitY Exports
entries.snippet: Offers an incentive of 4% to 6% on incremental sales (over base year) of goods manufactured in India to boost domestic electronic component manufacturing and attract large investments.

entries.scheme_name: Scheme for Promotion of Manufacturing of Electronic Components and Semiconductors
entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
entries.text: Scheme for Promotion of Manufacturing of Electronic Components and Semiconductors SPECS Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology Financial incentive of 25% on capital expenditure for the manufacturing of identified electronic components, semiconductor packaging, display fabrication, and active components. Investment in new manufacturing unit or expansion of existing units for eligible electronic items. Minimum capital expenditure investment threshold ranges from ₹5 Crore to ₹1,000 Crore depending on product category. Application must be submitted prior to placing orders for plant and machinery. 25% financial incentive on eligible capital expenditure for plant, machinery, equipment, associated utilities, and clean room facilities. specs semiconductors electronic-components pcb capital-expenditure Electronics Semiconductor Passive Components PCB Hardware
entries.snippet: Financial incentive of 25% on capital expenditure for the manufacturing of identified electronic components, semiconductor packaging, display fabrication, and active components.

entries.scheme_name: Scheme for Promotion of Manufacturing of Electronic Components and Semiconductors (SPECS)
entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
entries.text: Scheme for Promotion of Manufacturing of Electronic Components and Semiconductors (SPECS) SPECS Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) Provides 25% financial incentive on capital expenditure for the manufacturing of electronic goods that form the supply chain of electronic products. Investments in new electronic component manufacturing units or expansion/modernization of existing units. Minimum investment threshold ranging from ₹5 Crore to ₹1,000 Crore depending on component category. 25% financial incentive on capital expenditure for plant, machinery, equipment, associated utilities, and technology transfer. Semiconductors Hardware SPECS Electronics Capex Components Semiconductors Components Hardware SPECS Electronics Capex
entries.snippet: Provides 25% financial incentive on capital expenditure for the manufacturing of electronic goods that form the supply chain of electronic products.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry / Ministry of Finance
entries.text: Section 80-IAC Tax Exemption for Startups 80-IAC Ministry of Commerce and Industry / Ministry of Finance 100% income tax deduction on profits and gains for 3 consecutive financial years out of the first 10 years since incorporation for eligible innovative startups. Incorporated as a Private Limited Company or LLP between April 1, 2016 and March 31, 2025 (or as extended in Finance Act). Total turnover should not exceed ₹100 Crore in any of the previous financial years. Entity must be certified by the Inter-Ministerial Board (IMB) of Certification as an innovative business working towards innovation, development or improvement of products or processes. Company should not be formed by splitting up or reconstruction of an existing business. 100% tax holiday on corporate income profits for any 3 consecutive assessment years chosen by the startup within its first 10 years. tax-holiday 80-iac income-tax dpiit imb-approval innovation ALL
entries.snippet: 100% income tax deduction on profits and gains for 3 consecutive financial years out of the first 10 years since incorporation for eligible innovative startups.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Finance - Department of Financial Services
entries.text: Stand-Up India Scheme StandUp-India Ministry of Finance - Department of Financial Services Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises. SC/ST and/or woman entrepreneurs above 18 years of age. Loans under the scheme are available only for greenfield projects (the first-time venture of the beneficiary in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities, or trading). In case of non-individual enterprises, 51% of the shareholding and controlling stake must be held by either SC/ST and/or women entrepreneur. Borrower should not be in default to any bank or financial institution. Composite loan (term loan and working capital) between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore covering up to 85% of total project cost. women-entrepreneurs sc-st greenfield bank-loan sidbi ALL
entries.snippet: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.

entries.scheme_name: Stand-Up India Scheme for Women and SC/ST Entrepreneurs
entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Finance
entries.text: Stand-Up India Scheme for Women and SC/ST Entrepreneurs STAND-UP INDIA Ministry of Finance Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise. SC/ST and/or Woman entrepreneurs above 18 years of age. Loans under the scheme are available for only greenfield (first-time) projects. In case of non-individual enterprises, 51% shareholding must be held by SC/ST and/or women. Borrower must not be in default to any bank or financial institution. Composite loan (term loan and working capital) between ₹10 Lakh and ₹100 Lakh covering up to 85% of project cost at lowest applicable bank interest rate. Finance Bank Loan Greenfield SC/ST Women Entrepreneurship Women Entrepreneurship SC/ST Greenfield Bank Loan Finance
entries.snippet: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
entries.text: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme SISFS Ministry of Commerce and Industry Financial assistance to early-stage DPIIT-recognized startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry, and commercialization. A startup recognized by DPIIT, incorporated not more than 2 years ago at the time of application. Must have a viable business idea with proof of concept or prototype. Must not have received more than ₹10 Lakh in monetary support under other Central or State government schemes. Indian promoters must hold at least 51% shareholding in the startup. Up to ₹20 Lakh as grant for Proof of Concept / prototype validation; up to ₹50 Lakh through convertible debentures or debt-linked instruments for commercialization. Prototype Seed Capital Incubator DPIIT Grant Startup Startup Seed Capital Grant Incubator Prototype DPIIT
entries.snippet: Financial assistance to early-stage DPIIT-recognized startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry, and commercialization.

entries.scheme_name: TIDE 2.0 Scheme (Technology Incubation and Development of Entrepreneurs)
entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
entries.text: TIDE 2.0 Scheme (Technology Incubation and Development of Entrepreneurs) TIDE 2.0 Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology Supports ICT and emerging technology startups (IoT, AI, Blockchain, Robotics) through 51 specialized incubation centers with Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EiR) and prototype grants. Aspiring tech entrepreneurs or early-stage startups working on emerging technology solutions (AI, IoT, Blockchain, CleanTech). Applicant must be incubated or willing to incubate at a recognized TIDE 2.0 incubation center. Focus on solving societal challenges in healthcare, education, agriculture, or financial inclusion. Grant support: Up to ₹7 Lakh for Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EiR) fellows, and up to ₹40 Lakh Grant/Equity for Proof of Concept & commercialization. deeptech iot artificial-intelligence eir incubator-grant Information Technology Artificial Intelligence Robotics IoT Healthcare Tech FinTech
entries.snippet: Supports ICT and emerging technology startups (IoT, AI, Blockchain, Robotics) through 51 specialized incubation centers with Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EiR) and prototype grants.

entries.scheme_name: Tax Exemption under Section 80-IAC of Income Tax Act
entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
entries.text: Tax Exemption under Section 80-IAC of Income Tax Act SECTION 80-IAC Ministry of Commerce and Industry Eligible startups can get 100% deduction on corporate profits for 3 consecutive financial years out of their first 10 years of incorporation. Incorporated as a Private Limited Company or Limited Liability Partnership (LLP). Incorporated between 1st April 2016 and 31st March 2025 (as extended). Annual turnover must not exceed ₹100 Crore in any financial year. Working towards innovation, development, or commercialization of new products, processes, or services. 100% income tax exemption on profits for 3 consecutive assessment years chosen by the startup within the 10-year period. Startups Tax Relief 80-IAC Corporate Tax IMB Approval Tax Relief 80-IAC Corporate Tax Startups IMB Approval
entries.snippet: Eligible startups can get 100% deduction on corporate profits for 3 consecutive financial years out of their first 10 years of incorporation.

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
entries.text: MINISTRY OF MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES MSME SUSTAINABLE (ZED) CERTIFICATION SCHEME OPERATIONAL CIRCULAR 1. Policy Objective: To facilitate MSMEs to adopt Zero Defect Zero Effect manufacturing practices and attain world-class standards. 2. Qualifying Criteria: 1. Open to all Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises with valid Udyam Registration. 2. Applicable exclusively to active manufacturing units across all industrial sectors. 3. 10 percent additional subsidy for women and SC/ST owned manufacturing units. 3. Quantum of Assistance: 1. Subsidy of 80 % subsidy on assessment and certification fees for Micro enterprises. 2. 60 percent subsidy for Small enterprises and 50 percent for Medium enterprises. 3. Maximum financial assistance cap of Rs 5 Lakh per enterprise. 4. Mandatory Documents Checklist: 1. Udyam Registration Certificate 2. Factory License or Consent to Operate 3. Self-declaration on energy and quality compliance 4. Bank Account Details and Cancelled Cheque

entries.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
entries.text: GOVERNMENT OF INDIA - MINISTRY OF MSME OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PRIME MINISTER EMPLOYMENT GENERATION PROGRAMME (PMEGP) 1. Overview & Objective: To generate continuous self-employment opportunities for micro enterprises in rural and urban areas. 2. Eligibility Criteria: 1. Any individual above 18 years of age is eligible to apply. 2. Minimum VIII standard pass required for manufacturing projects above Rs 10 Lakh. 3. Only new greenfield enterprises are eligible for initial funding. 4. Self Help Groups (SHGs) and Charitable Trusts are also eligible. 3. Financial Assistance and Subsidy: 1. Margin money subsidy of 35 % margin money subsidy for rural special categories. 2. General category gets 15 percent urban and 25 percent rural subsidy. 3. Maximum project cost cap is Rs 50 Lakh for manufacturing and Rs 20 Lakh for services. 4. Documents Required: 1. Aadhaar Card and PAN Card 2. Detailed Project Report (DPR) 3. Educational Marksheet (Class 8th Certificate) 4. Special Category / Caste Certificate if applicable 5. Gram Panchayat Rural Certificate
